description_en: Creates a Logstash pipeline to collect data
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch create-pipelines --instance-id ls-cn-oew1qbgl0000 --trigger false --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --biz-body queueMaxBytes=1024 description=this_is_a_test queueType=MEMORY queueCheckPointWrites=1024 batchDelay=50 batchSize=125 config=input_filter_output workers=2 pipelineId=pipeline-test --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePipelines

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to save and deploy the pipeline. Valid values:

- true: Save and deploy.
- false (default): Save only.
